scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Greetings, adventurer.
I'm a member of the Hypnotist
Academy sent here to Prontera
to provide Skill Reset services
to certain First Class characters for a really good price: free!
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
你好，冒險者。
我是催眠師學院派來普隆德拉的成員，專為符合條件的一轉職業提供技能重置服務，價格絕對優惠：免費！

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Although I offer unlimited
skill resets for now, I have
two conditions that must be
fulfilled. First, you must be
lower than ^FF0000Base Level 40^000000.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
我目前提供不限次數的技能重置，但必須滿足兩個條件。
首先，你的等級必須低於^FF0000基礎等級40級^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Second, you must be a
^FF0000Swordman, Acolyte, Mage,
Thief, Archer, Merchant,
Taekwon Boy, Taekwon Girl, Gunslinger and Ninja^000000
Job character to qualify.
Now, do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
其次，你必須是以下職業之一才有資格：
^FF0000劍士、服事、魔法師、盜賊、弓箭手、商人、跆拳男孩、跆拳女孩、神槍手和忍者^000000。
那麼，你有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: Skill Reset?
scripts.translation: 技能重置？

scripts.text: I want a Skill Reset
scripts.translation: 我要進行技能重置

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Skill Resets allow adventuers
to redistribute their Skill
Points if they are unhappy
with their current skills.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
如果你不滿意當前的技能配置，可以通過技能重置來重新分配技能點。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Before proceeding with
a Skill Reset, you must
reduce all of the weight
of all carried items on your
character to 0. You can put
extra items in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
重置技能前，必須先將角色攜帶物品的總重量降至0。
你可以把多餘的物品存進卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Ah, it's also important
to remove your ^FF0000Pushcart^000000
if you have one equipped.
Otherwise, hypnosis won't
work, or will backfire...
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
啊，如果你裝備了^FF0000手推車^000000，也請務必將其卸下。
否則，催眠可能無效，或者產生反效果...

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Are you sure that you
want to proceed with
my ^FF0000Skill Reset^000000 service?
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
你確定要使用我的^FF0000技能重置^000000服務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
I'm sorry, but characters
with Base Levels higher
than 40 are ineligible for the
Skill Reset service I provide.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
抱歉，基礎等級超過40級的角色無法使用我的技能重置服務。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Oh! Please remove your
Pushcart before proceeding
with the Skill Reset service.
Thanks for cooperating~
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
哦！重置技能前，請先卸下手推車。
謝謝配合~

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
If you're here for my Skill
Reset service, please
remember that you can't
reset your skills until the
^FF0000weight of your carried items in
your Inventory is reduced to 0^000000.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
如果你是來重置技能的，請記住：必須先將^FF0000物品欄中所攜物品的總重量降至0^000000，才能重置技能。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Why don't you place your
things into the Kafra Storage
for now? That way, you can
safely keep all of your goods.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
不如先把東西存進卡普拉倉庫吧？
這樣就能妥善保管你的物品了。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Thank you for using
my Skill Redistribution
services. Oh, and best
of luck to you on your
travels, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
感謝使用我的技能點重新分配服務。
冒險者，祝你旅途順利！

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
I'm sorry, but your
Job Class doesn't qualify
for the Skill Reset service
that I provide. I can only
offer Skill Resets to the
following Jobs...
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
抱歉，你的職業不符合技能重置服務的條件。
我只能為以下職業重置技能...

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
^FF0000Swordman, Acolyte,
Mage, Thief, Archer,
Merchant, Taekwon
Boy, Taekwon Girl, Gunslinger and Ninja^000000.
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
^FF0000劍士、服事、魔法師、盜賊、弓箭手、商人、跆拳男孩、跆拳女孩、神槍手和忍者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Thank you, and good
luck on your adventures.
Please travel in safety~
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
謝謝，祝你冒險順利。
路上注意安全~

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Thank you, and good
luck on your adventures.
Please travel in safety~
scripts.translation:
[催眠師]
謝謝，祝你冒險順利。
路上注意安全~
